summary: Read-only freestanding s5e9945 DECON0/DPP boot-window reader with every register offset and bit field cited from pinned Samsung source (checked line by line at s24-linux and s24-bsp-reference), MMIO bases from the NAT-005 runtime FDT, and ASan/UBSan host tests on a guard-page read-only simulated register file encoded with Samsung's own macro bodies. Review fixed one test defect (page-rounded 0x9A4000 taken as the exact frame size) and two validation gaps (block mode, colormap window stacked above the frame). Nothing ran on the phone.

sources.note: Local checkouts are blob:none partial clones; no blob is missing under drivers/gpu/drm/samsung, drivers/video, init or arch/arm64/boot/dts/exynos (three unrelated symlink blobs missing elsewhere).

device_io.note: No ADB, no su, no MMIO. The runtime FDT is the private NAT-005 copy already on the host.

host_commands.result: 1 failure: test_validation_rejections expected SIZE for 0x9A3FFC, which holds the 0x9A3F80-byte frame (test defect)
byte-identical to docs/procedures/ui-007/dpu-dt-facts.json; blob SHA-256 matches NAT-005

argv: mutation check: six single-point mutations of e1s_boot_window.c, suite run per mutant, source restored and compared
host_commands.result: 6/6 killed: no-block-check, no-covered-check, pitch-from-crop-width, end-exclusive, skip-shadow, chmap-shift-wrong

host_commands.note: skips need references/ absent in the worktree

acceptance.criterion: cal_rt DECON window enable/channel map and DPP/DMA base, pitch, format and size offsets cited file:line from s24-linux and s24-bsp-reference; s3cfb.bootloaderfb consumption cited
DPP/DMA MMIO bases from the NAT-005 runtime FDT, sanitized
freestanding read-only C module returning {enabled, base, stride, format, width, height}, validating base/size, compiling for aarch64 freestanding with loader flags
clang ASan/UBSan host tests on a simulated register file encoded from cited definitions, with rejection cases
acceptance.where: tests/test_native_boot_window.py (22 tests) and the mutation check above

acceptance.criterion: report separates cited, measured and unverified facts; no device I/O

limits: Host-test and source-review only: the reader has not run on the S24 and no register value of this phone was read.
Runtime FDT facts are from a normal Android boot; RECOVERY-boot state is not observed.

Power/clock state of DECON0/DPP/SysMMU at loader time, actual window/format/stride, SysMMU bypass, shadow agreement on an idle command-mode panel and pitch derivation without DMA_STRIDE_SEL remain native-run questions.
No hardware GPU or display output is claimed.
